_comment: Permission profile for workforce `worker` sessions. Passed with --settings.
Deployed from this repo's config/perm/ by the sync script; edit it here.
The point of this file is that a background session does NOT need bypass
mode. Anything not allowed here forwards a prompt to the Claude app and the
session parks at state `waiting` until someone answers. Allow the routine,
deny the load-bearing, let the rest ask.
The deny list is the second boundary. A repo with a hook layer can refuse
these in .claude/hooks/ as well. A repo without one has nothing else
carrying the rule, so there this file is the only thing that does.
